title: String Comparison
problem: Compare strings correctly and print YES if equal, else NO.
starterCode: import java.util.*; class Main{ public static void main(String[] args){ Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in); String a=sc.nextLine(); String b=sc.nextLine(); if(a==b){ System.out.println("YES"); } else { System.out.println("NO"); } } }
